description_en: Retrieves the details of a configuration export task for a Bastionhost instance
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-export-config-job --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --job-id 2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetExportConfigJob

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the configuration backup export job.

This parameter is the JobId returned after you successfully call the CreateExportConfigJob operation to create a configuration backup export job
parameters.help_zh:
配置备份导出任务ID。
该参数为调用CreateExportConfigJob接口创建配置备份导出任务成功后的返回参数JobId
parameters.name: job_id

DownloadUrl.description_en: The download link of the configuration backup file
DownloadUrl.description_zh: 配置备份文件下载链接

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the configuration backup download link. (In seconds, UNIX timestamp format)
ExpireTime.description_zh: 配置备份下载链接过期时间。（秒，时间戳格式）

JobId.description_en: The ID of the configuration backup export job

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Status.description_en: The status of the configuration backup export job
Status.description_zh: 配置备份导出任务状态
